meta.name: agent-wrap-up
meta.description: Orchestrates the final project state synchronization, including changelog updates, feature documentation, and cross-reference validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目收尾变成自动更新日志与文档同步
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次交付前都要同步文档和变更记录。
copy.tagline_en: Turn project wrap-up into auto-updated changelogs and docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must sync documentation and change logs before every release.

howto.what: 装上此技能后,Claude 会在项目收尾时扮演「上下文架构师」,自动更新变更日志、为新增功能/组件写文档、核对并修正旧文档中的过期引用、把完成的计划归档到 archive、清除 backlog 中已解决的事项,并记录项目知识。
howto.when: 当一次主要开发任务完成,你说“wrap up”“ship it”等收尾词,或正在关闭功能分支/修复 bug 时触发。

say.text: 我们做完了,帮我 wrap up 一下。
say.note: 触发技能执行完整的收尾流程。

say.text: 把今天的改动同步到 changelog 和文档里。
say.note: 会更新日志并核对文档引用。

say.text: 这个计划已完成,归档并清理 backlog。

howto.what_en: As a Lead Context Architect, Claude updates the changelog, documents new features/components, fixes stale doc references, archives completed plans, removes resolved backlog items, and records project knowledge.
howto.when_en: Activated when a primary development task is done, when you say phrases like 'wrap up' or 'ship it', or when closing a feature branch or bug fix.

say_en.text: We're done — please wrap up the project.
Update the changelog and docs with today's changes.
This plan is complete; archive it and clean the backlog.
say_en.note: Moves plan to archive and removes resolved items.
